decisions.reason: Having remained on the market beyond its launch year and fitting tightly with the firm's core cloud communication platform, Product A likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels that a large firm with some slack would continue it rather than redeploy resources.

As a very new product closely related to the established offer in a growing market, Product B is still in the period where management would tolerate some uncertainty and learn from early results unless performance clearly falls below aspirations.

Because Product C is also a new, adjacent extension of the firm's secure messaging portfolio, the firm is likely to keep it while evaluating uptake against aspiration levels, with enough organizational slack to avoid an early withdrawal.
